title.rendered: Best Sleeves for the 14-inch MacBook Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
If you’ve just picked up Apple’s 14-inch MacBook Pro M5, you already know how premium and powerful it is. But that sleek aluminum design deserves proper protection when you’re on the go. A sleeve is one of the simplest accessories you can buy. It shields your MacBook from scratches, dust, and bumps without adding bulk.  

In this guide, we’ll look at what makes a good laptop sleeve, then explore the top 7 options for the 14-inch MacBook Pro. I’ve included sleeves with minimalist style, premium materials, and extra functionality so you’ll find one that fits your needs. 

Table of Contents
  • Key Factors to Consider Before Buying
  • 7 Best 14-inch MacBook Pro Sleeves
    • 1. tomtoc 360 Protective Laptop Sleeve
    • 2. Orbitkey Hybrid Laptop Sleeve
    • 3. MOFT 2-in-1 MacBook Sleeve & Stand
    • 4. Lacdo Laptop Sleeve Bag
    • 5. JETech Slim Leather Sleeve
    • 6. MOSISO Laptop Sleeve Bag with Small Case
    • 7. Casemade Real Leather MacBook Sleeve
  • Final Verdict: Which MacBook Pro Sleeve Should You Buy?

Key Factors to Consider Before Buying 

Before adding anything to your cart, here are a few points to keep in mind: 

  • Size and Fit: Your sleeve should fit the 14-inch MacBook Pro snugly. Too tight and you risk scratching the surface while removing it. Loose fit makes your MacBook slide around inside. Always check compatibility before buying. 
  • Material and Protection: Common materials include neoprene, felt, polyester, leather, or hybrid composites. Harder materials generally have better impact resistance, while softer ones are more comfortable to carry and store.
  • Interior Padding: That should be soft enough inside to avoid scratching the finish on your MacBook. Some sleeves incorporate additional foam padding or corner bumpers for drop protection.
  • Water Resistance: If you frequently commute or travel, a water-resistant outer layer can save your MacBook from accidental spills or rain. 
  • Extra Storage: Do you carry a charger, cables, or an external SSD? Some sleeves include extra compartments or accessory pockets for that. 
  • Design and Portability: Sleek, professional designs look great for work, while colorful or textured sleeves might appeal to creatives. Consider whether you want handles, a strap, or a simple slip-in style. 
  • Budget: Expect $15–$30 for basics, up to $80+ for fancy features like stands or mouse pads.

7 Best 14-inch MacBook Pro Sleeves

Here I are some of the best MacBook sleeves, selected for their usability and unique features.

1. tomtoc 360 Protective Laptop Sleeve

tomtoc sleeves come in a couple of colors and designs, but each one nails everyday usability for the 14-inch MacBook Pro M5. The classic version uses recycled fabrics with CornerArmor tech, high-resilience edges, and high-density inner padding. Thus, the sleeve provides military-grade drop protection without bulk.

Moreover, it’s water-resistant, has a soft lining to avoid scratches, and includes a front pocket for accessories and an additional strap for your AirTag or key. tomtoc’s new Protective Puffy Laptop Sleeve amps up the lightweight feel with a quilted design like a plush cushion.

It’s great for users who travel or commute daily, thanks to the unbeatable protection-to-price ratio and eco-friendly material. However, the front pocket is small for big chargers. 

Best for: Users who want maximum protection without extra weight. 

2. Orbitkey Hybrid Laptop Sleeve

Orbitkey products are known for quality and innovation, and its Hybrid Laptop Sleeve is no exception. It doubles as a carry case and workstation. Made from vegan leather and recycled woven fabric, it houses your 14-inch MBP safe with a silent magnetic closure.

Flip its tri-fold open, and the interior doubles as a mouse pad/desk mat, perfect for impromptu workspace setups. It’s not the most padded sleeve on this list, but the combination of style, utility, and sustainability makes it a premium choice for people who work on the go. 

However, there’s no dedicated pocket for extras, and it’s a bit pricier for basics. 

Best for: Remote workers or students who want a sleeve that doubles as a portable desk mat. 

3. MOFT 2-in-1 MacBook Sleeve & Stand

MOFT’s 2-in-1 Laptop Carry Sleeve is all about slim, smart design. Its heavy-duty PU material safes your MacBook from scratches and daily wear. Though the sleeve is only 0.28″ thin, you get an expandable back pocket for chargers, and it slips into any bag without fuss.

The best part? The sleeve folds into an invisible stand with 15- or 25-degree angles, easing neck strain during long sessions. So, it’s a smart buy for remote pros who work on laptops or tablets. But it’s not drop-proof, and the PU vegan material might wear faster. 

Best for: Minimalists and remote professionals who value flexibility and aesthetics. 

4. Lacdo Laptop Sleeve Bag

Lacdo’s Protective Briefcase keeps it practical with anti-scratch canvas fabric, a water-repellent coating, shockproof fleece lining, and three pockets (two zippered front pockets, one back flap) for all your gear. The top metal zipper opens wide for easy grabs, and thickened edges cushion daily jostles. 

While carrying your MacBook, you can use the grab-handle on top. It’s stretchable, so you can switch between a laptop briefcase, handbag, and laptop sleeve bag. Overall, it’s a no-brainer for budget users and commuters who want to stuff it with extras, though it can feel baggy on the slim MacBook Pro.

Best for: Budget-conscious users who want solid all-around protection. 

5. JETech Slim Leather Sleeve

JETech delivers straightforward shielding with waterproof PU leather and soft lining. It has a modern, minimalist look with a magnetic flap closure that’s both elegant and functional. The envelope-style insert makes sliding in quick. 

Additionally, the sleeve is ultra-slim, making it perfect for slipping into a backpack or tote. That said, there’s no extra pocket, so it’s ideal for those who travel light. Also, the minimal padding is not for rough use. 

Best for: Users who prefer a simple, slim sleeve for light commuting. 

6. MOSISO Laptop Sleeve Bag with Small Case

MOSISO’s neoprene sleeve comes with a matching mini-pouch for mouse or cables, in a rainbow of colors to match your vibe. Its triple-layered design with elastic neoprene, shockproof sponge, and fluffy fleece lining absorbs bumps well and fits the MBP snugly. 

Moreover, the soft Lycra exterior is water-resistant. The sleeve comes in a variety of colors, making it a fun option for students or casual users. It’s budget-friendly, lightweight, soft, and flexible, but not the best for heavy protection.

Best for: Students or casual users who want a colorful, affordable sleeve. 

7. Casemade Real Leather MacBook Sleeve

Casemade goes luxe with full-grain cowhide leather and wool felt lining that cradles your MacBook Pro softly, preventing slips. It’s hand-stitched for durability, aging into a patina that looks pro without trying.

With a slim, lightweight design, it fits bags seamlessly. While it doesn’t offer heavy-duty protection, it stands out for its professional, premium aesthetic, perfect for meetings or executive settings. 

Best for: Professionals who value elegance and craftsmanship over bulk. 

Final Verdict: Which MacBook Pro Sleeve Should You Buy? 

Your pick boils down to priorities. If you want the best all-around protection on a dime, the tomtoc sleeve is hard to beat. It’s rugged, well-built, and travel-ready. 

For those who work remotely or frequently move between spaces, the Orbitkey Hybrid and MOFT sleeve are smart, versatile choices. They offer a professional style with functional benefits, such as a mouse pad or an integrated stand. 

On the other hand, Lacdo is your storage champ with a briefcase design. And for anyone who just wants something simple and affordable, MOSISO or JETech gets the job done without breaking the bank. 

Ultimately, the best sleeve depends on how and where you use your laptop. Pick one that fits your lifestyle, and your 14-inch MacBook Pro will stay safe and stylish wherever you take it. 

So, which sleeve did you add to your cart? Let me know in the comments below!

@graph.name: tomtoc 360 Protective Laptop Sleeve
@graph.description: tomtoc sleeves come in a couple of colors and designs, but each one nails everyday usability for the 14-inch MacBook Pro M5. The classic version uses recycled fabrics with CornerArmor tech, high-resilience edges, and high-density inner padding. Thus, the sleeve provides military-grade drop protection without bulk.

@graph.name: Orbitkey Hybrid Laptop Sleeve
@graph.description: Orbitkey products are known for quality and innovation, and its Hybrid Laptop Sleeve is no exception. It doubles as a carry case and workstation. Made from vegan leather and recycled woven fabric, it houses your 14-inch MBP safe with a silent magnetic closure.

@graph.name: MOFT 2-in-1 MacBook Sleeve & Stand
@graph.description: MOFT’s 2-in-1 Laptop Carry Sleeve is all about slim, smart design. Its heavy-duty PU material safes your MacBook from scratches and daily wear. Though the sleeve is only 0.28″ thin, you get an expandable back pocket for chargers, and it slips into any bag without fuss.

@graph.name: Lacdo Laptop Sleeve Bag
@graph.description: Lacdo’s Protective Briefcase keeps it practical with anti-scratch canvas fabric, a water-repellent coating, shockproof fleece lining, and three pockets (two zippered front pockets, one back flap) for all your gear. The top metal zipper opens wide for easy grabs, and thickened edges cushion daily jostles.

@graph.name: JETech Slim Leather Sleeve
@graph.description: JETech delivers straightforward shielding with waterproof PU leather and soft lining. It has a modern, minimalist look with a magnetic flap closure that’s both elegant and functional. The envelope-style insert makes sliding in quick.

@graph.name: MOSISO Laptop Sleeve Bag with Small Case
@graph.description: MOSISO’s neoprene sleeve comes with a matching mini-pouch for mouse or cables, in a rainbow of colors to match your vibe. Its triple-layered design with elastic neoprene, shockproof sponge, and fluffy fleece lining absorbs bumps well and fits the MBP snugly.

@graph.name: Casemade Real Leather MacBook Sleeve
@graph.description: Casemade goes luxe with full-grain cowhide leather and wool felt lining that cradles your MacBook Pro softly, preventing slips. It’s hand-stitched for durability, aging into a patina that looks pro without trying.

title.rendered: How to Factory Reset Apple Watch: Step-by-Step Guide

content.rendered:
Your Apple Watch can usually handle anything you throw at it, but even the best tech sometimes needs a quick restart or a full reset. Whether it’s frozen, unresponsive, or you’ve forgotten the passcode, learning how to factory reset your Apple Watch the right way can save you time and frustration.

Table of Contents
  • How to Restart Apple Watch (Soft Reset)
    • Watch this tutorial to learn how to restart or force restart your Apple Watch.
  • How to Factory Reset Apple Watch (Hard Reset)
    • Method 1: Unpair Apple Watch To Reset Automatically
    • Method 2: Reset Directly from the Watch
    • Method 3: Reset Apple Watch Using iPhone
    • Method 4: Alternate Button Combination Reset (Last Resort)
  • Important Safety Tips for Apple Watch Reset
  • What to Do After Resetting Apple Watch
  • Restart and reboot your Apple Watch to get a fresh start!

How to Restart Apple Watch (Soft Reset)

Restarting your Apple Watch fixes small glitches without deleting data. It’s like rebooting your iPhone, quick and harmless.

Before restarting, make sure your watch isn’t on charge.

  1. Press and hold the Side Button until the Power Off slider appears.
  2. Drag the Power Off slider to shut down your watch.
  3. Wait a few seconds, then press and hold the Side Button again until you see the Apple logo.

If your Apple Watch is frozen and unresponsive, try a force restart: press and hold both the Side Button and Digital Crown for at least 10 seconds until the Apple logo appears.

This doesn’t erase your data; it just refreshes your system and clears temporary issues.

Watch this tutorial to learn how to restart or force restart your Apple Watch.

How to Factory Reset Apple Watch (Hard Reset)

A hard reset, or factory reset, wipes your Apple Watch clean. Use this when you forget your passcode, plan to sell or give it away, or when nothing else works.

Method 1: Unpair Apple Watch To Reset Automatically

If you can access your iPhone, unpairing your watch is always the best way to reset it. It removes Activation Lock and automatically creates a backup.

  1. Keep your iPhone and Apple Watch close.
  2. Open the Watch app > All Watches > tap the info (i) icon next to your watch.
  3. Tap Unpair Apple Watch.
  4. Enter your Apple ID password to disable Activation Lock.
  5. For GPS + Cellular models, choose whether to keep or remove your mobile plan.

After unpairing, your watch shows the Start Pairing screen and your iPhone stores the backup. For more details, check out our guide on unpairing an Apple Watch.

Method 2: Reset Directly from the Watch

You can reset your Apple Watch even without your iPhone, but it must stay connected to the charger during the process.

  1. Open the Settings app on Apple Watch and go to General.
  2. Select the Reset option, then tap Erase all content and Settings.
  3. Enter your passcode.
  4. Wait for the reset to finish, then set up your watch again.
Note This erases all data but doesn’t remove Activation Lock. You’ll need the Apple ID and password used with the watch to set it up again.

Method 3: Reset Apple Watch Using iPhone

If your iPhone is still paired, this is the easiest and safest way to reset your watch; it also automatically removes Activation Lock.

  1. Keep your Apple Watch and iPhone close together.
  2. Open the Watch app on your iPhone.
  3. Go to My Watch > General > Reset.
  4. Tap Erase Apple Watch Content and Settings.
  5. Confirm and enter your Apple ID password if asked.

If you have a GPS + Cellular model, you’ll see an option to either keep or remove your mobile plan. Keep it if you’ll pair with the same iPhone again, or remove it if you’re selling or switching devices.

Your iPhone automatically backs up your Apple Watch before resetting it, so you can restore everything later.

Method 4: Alternate Button Combination Reset (Last Resort)

If your Apple Watch doesn’t respond to any standard reset method, try this. This may not work on recent models, but for any old models like the Apple Watch Series 2, this should work even now:

  1. Press and hold both the Side Button and Digital Crown for about 10 seconds until the Apple logo appears.
  2. Wait a few seconds, then hold only the Side Button for around 20 seconds until the reset option appears.
  3. Tap Erase All Settings, then confirm with the green check button.

Important Safety Tips for Apple Watch Reset

  • Never insert anything into the small holes on your Apple Watch; they’re not reset buttons. They’re for the microphone, speakers, and water-depth sensors.
  • Unpair from iPhone first if you’re selling or giving your watch away. This ensures Activation Lock is removed.
  • Use the charger while resetting to prevent interruptions or damage.

What to Do After Resetting Apple Watch

Once your Apple Watch restarts or resets, it’s time to set it up again.

  • Set up as new for a fresh start.
  • Restore from backup to get all your old data back.

After setup, reconnect to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, pair it with your iPhone, re-add Apple Pay cards, reinstall apps, and re-enable Health and Activity tracking.

If your Apple Watch still doesn’t respond or won’t reset even after trying everything, contact Apple Support for help.

Restarting or resetting your Apple Watch can often solve most issues, from a stuck screen to a forgotten passcode. It’s a simple fix that can save hours of frustration and make your watch feel brand new again.

Restart and reboot your Apple Watch to get a fresh start!

In short, restarting or resetting your Apple Watch isn’t something to fear; it’s often the quickest way to bring it back to life. A simple restart clears small bugs, while a full reset gives your watch a clean slate when nothing else works. Just remember to unpair it first if you’re switching devices or selling it. Once you’ve set it up again, your Apple Watch will feel as smooth and responsive as the day you bought it.

  • Apple Watch Faces You Must Try
  • Apple Watch stuck on the Apple Logo?
  • How to Mirror Your Apple Watch on Your iPhone

keyPoints.title: How to Factory Reset Your Apple Watch with an iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: You can easily reset your Apple Watch using the Watch app on your paired iPhone, which also removes Activation Lock and unpairs the device.

keyPoints.title: Factory Resetting Your Apple Watch Without an iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: If your iPhone isn't nearby, you can reset your Apple Watch directly from the device by using the Settings app and erasing all content and settings.

keyPoints.title: Resetting Apple Watch Without a Passcode
keyPoints.explanation: To reset an Apple Watch without a passcode, connect it to a charger, force a reset through the side button and Digital Crown, then confirm the reset.

keyPoints.title: Removing Activation Lock After Reset
keyPoints.explanation: Factory resetting via the iPhone removes Activation Lock automatically, but resetting directly on the watch requires removing it from your Apple ID account separately.

keyPoints.title: Important Note on Activation Lock Removal
keyPoints.explanation: To fully remove Activation Lock, the previous owner must remove the Apple Watch from their Apple ID via the Find My app, as a reset alone doesn't disable the lock.

title.rendered: Best Cases for Apple Watch Ultra 3, Ultra 2, and Ultra

content.rendered:
The Apple Watch Ultra series has become a go-to for anyone who wants a tough smartwatch that can handle tough conditions, from gym sessions to outdoor hikes. But even with its built-in durability, adding a case can give you that extra layer of peace of mind.  

In this guide, we’ll break down whether you really need a case for your Apple Watch Ultra and look at the top 6 best cases that balance protection, style, and everyday use.

Table of Contents
  • Do I Need a Case for My Apple Watch Ultra?
  • 6 Best Cases for Apple Watch Ultra Series
    • 1. Spigen Thin Fit Case
    • 2. ESR Case with Armorite Screen Protector
    • 3. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Watch Case and Band
    • 4. amBand M1 Sport Case Band
    • 5. Misxi Thin Protective Case
    • 6. MAGEASY Rugged Metal Case
  • Which Apple Watch Ultra Case Should You Buy?
  • Conclusion

Do I Need a Case for My Apple Watch Ultra? 

The Apple Watch Ultra is Apple’s most rugged smartwatch yet. It comes with a titanium case, a sapphire crystal display, water resistance up to 100 meters, and MIL-STD-810H certification for extreme conditions. So technically, you don’t need a case if you’re mostly using it for casual tracking or office days.  

However, if you love outdoor adventures, gym workouts, or physically demanding activities, a protective case can be a smart investment. Even though titanium is durable, it’s not scratch-proof.

A fall on rough terrain or a scrape against metal gym equipment can still leave marks. A case can help protect your watch from unexpected drops, impacts, and scratches, keeping it looking pristine for longer. 

6 Best Cases for Apple Watch Ultra Series

The Apple Watch Ultra 3 has the same 49mm case diameter and bezel size as the Ultra 2 and the first Ultra, so all three can have the same cases. Six of the best are listed here, each providing a different level of protection, style, and usability.

1. Spigen Thin Fit Case

If you’re looking for a minimalist case, it’s perfect. Its premium polycarbonate shell is lightweight and slim, providing just enough protection against everyday scratches. With a minimal bezel lift, it focuses on bezel protection and maintains full touch sensitivity. 

Moreover, installation is a quick snap, with no band removal required. It’s ideal for urban commuters who want subtle protection without altering the watch’s profile. However, it won’t handle heavy impacts.  

There are two more cases for Apple Watch Ultra.  

  • Spigen Rugged Armor Case for people who need serious protection. 
  • Spigen Lock Fit Case for activities, when a strong lock can prevent accidental pressing of the Action Button.  

2. ESR Case with Armorite Screen Protector 

ESR’s military-grade case stands out for its aluminum alloy build that feels premium without the premium price. It’s designed for full wrap-around coverage that blends right into Ultra’s aesthetic without adding any bulk.  

Moreover, the included ultra-hard tempered glass protectors shield the sapphire display from scratches and impacts up to 110lbs without compromising touch sensitivity. You can easily install the case and screen protectors without detaching the watch straps. 

Overall, it’s a solid all-rounder for anyone who wants robust protection and premium aesthetics. 

3. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Watch Case and Band

This all-in-one from SUPCASE combines a rugged PC case with a fully adjustable TPU watch band, offering military-standard protection. The double-tongue buckle locks securely around the wrist, and raised bezels lift the screen a millimeter off the surface.  

You’ll also get two tempered glass screens to safeguard the display from scratches. Its precise cutouts keep all the buttons and wireless charging accessible. Overall, it’s a budget win for adventurers. However, the band feels stiffer and looks bulkier.

4. amBand M1 Sport Case Band

The amBand M1 turns your Ultra into an even more stylish and sports-ready device with its stainless-steel connectors and TPU bumper frame. Its brushed metal patch adds grip without snagging sleeves. The included band is breathable and sweat-wicking. 

The included 9H tempered glass screen protector adds an extra layer of protection without affecting touch responsiveness. It’s a great choice for those who want their Apple Watch Ultra to look tough yet modern. 

5. Misxi Thin Protective Case

If you prefer a lightweight and barely-there design, Misxi’s Thin Protective Case might be your match. It has an ultra-thin hard PC shell with built-in tempered glass for protecting the screen and edges. So, the display remains scratch-proof, clear, and touch-sensitive.  

The case molds exactly to the Ultra’s curves, with hollowed crowns and button covers that keep presses snappy. Overall, it’s perfect for people who want to maintain the sleek Apple aesthetic without adding bulk. However, it’s not for high-impact sports, so use it accordingly. 

6. MAGEASY Rugged Metal Case

MAGEASY’s Odyssey case features premium aircraft-grade aluminum with a TPU bumper, similar to the Ultra’s anodized finish. Its 2-in-1 layers absorb shocks, with raised bezels that shield the screen during face-down drops. It keeps scratches at bay while providing your watch with an edgy, fashion-forward look.

It’s a little heavier than plastic or TPU cases, but the build quality and design feel high-end, making it suitable for those who value both protection and style. Band swaps are effortless, as you don’t need to remove the case, and it works with most chargers. 

Which Apple Watch Ultra Case Should You Buy? 

Choosing the right case depends on your lifestyle and how you use your Apple Watch Ultra: 

  • For the ultimate protection: Opt for the SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro or amBand M1 case. They’re built for rugged environments.
  • For protection and style in balance: The ESR case provides robust protection with an elegant design.
  • For light daily protection: Get the Spigen Thin Fit or Misxi Slim Case. They are ideal for everyday use without altering the watch’s appearance.  
  • For premium design lovers: The MAGEASY Metal Case stands out with its elegant, machined-metal appearance.

Conclusion

Ultimately, even though the Apple Watch Ultra is rugged on its own, adding a case can help you preserve its beauty and extend its life, especially if you lead an active lifestyle. Whether you go minimalist or heavy-duty, there’s a perfect case out there for your Ultra.  

Which case do you like the most? Let us know in the comments below!

mainEntity.name: How to search in iMessage?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you want to find something specific in the Messages app, you can perform a search. On the main All Messages screen, swipe down slightly to display the Search box at the top. Pop in your search term and you’ll see results from every conversation related to that term, including text, photos, links, or other items.

mainEntity.name: Do iMessage photos get saved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even with the Automatic Sharing feature enabled, as explained here, photos and videos you receive in Messages are not saved by default. If you delete the conversation, the photos will be deleted too. You can check out our how-to for saving photos from Messages to your iPhone or iPad to hold onto those important pictures.

@graph.name: Spigen Thin Fit Case for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: If you’re looking for a minimalist case, it’s perfect. Its premium polycarbonate shell is lightweight and slim, providing just enough protection against everyday scratches. With a minimal bezel lift, it focuses on bezel protection and maintains full touch sensitivity.

@graph.name: ESR Case with Armorite Screen Protector
@graph.description: ESR’s military-grade case stands out for its aluminum alloy build that feels premium without the premium price. It’s designed for full wrap-around coverage that blends right into Ultra’s aesthetic without adding any bulk.

@graph.name: SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Watch Case and Band
@graph.description: This all-in-one from SUPCASE combines a rugged PC case with a fully adjustable TPU watch band, offering military-standard protection. The double-tongue buckle locks securely around the wrist, and raised bezels lift the screen a millimeter off the surface.

@graph.name: amBand M1 Sport Case Band for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: The amBand M1 turns your Ultra into an even more stylish and sports-ready device with its stainless-steel connectors and TPU bumper frame. Its brushed metal patch adds grip without snagging sleeves. The included band is breathable and sweat-wicking.

@graph.name: Misxi Thin Protective Case for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: If you prefer a lightweight and barely-there design, Misxi’s Thin Protective Case might be your match. It has an ultra-thin hard PC shell with built-in tempered glass for protecting the screen and edges. So, the display remains scratch-proof, clear, and touch-sensitive.

@graph.name: MAGEASY Rugged Metal Case for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: MAGEASY’s Odyssey case features premium aircraft-grade aluminum with a TPU bumper, similar to the Ultra’s anodized finish. Its 2-in-1 layers absorb shocks, with raised bezels that shield the screen during face-down drops.
